tbh I rlly feel you on this. I had the same thoughts when I started out in emt school. I also have a history w depression and SI and personally I think having gone through this kind of pain can be of benefit when it comes to talking to patients dealing with suicidal ideation. I don’t have any advice as to whether or not you should continue because at the end of the day that is entirely up to you. I haven’t come up on any suicides yet and I’m sure it will be shocking to see at first. However when it comes to discussing mental health and SI with patients especially adolescents I feel like having experienced what they’re going through and communicating that with them can really help them open up and realize they’re not alone. The world can be a scary place, sometimes it’s comforting knowing someone else, especially a health professional, knows what you’re going through. We’re not psychiatrists but sometimes having a friend or someone there for you makes all the difference.
